messages:
sasha: Heads-up — we need to decide how exports surface 'actor' fields for routing/policy changes. Customer wants an auditable trail: who changed what, when, and why. We also need to balance PII concerns and export size :thinking_face:

raj: Agree. Main tradeoffs I see: full actor identity (email/tenant) vs pseudonymized id vs role-only. Also sampling for high-volume tenants so we don't explode export size.

morgan: From product: customers expect a downloadable bundle (NDJSON) that can be dropped into SIEMs. They also want link-back to console for quick investigation. Presigned links + TTL is fine.

elena: Security perspective: default should be pseudonymized. Full identity only for exports with enterprise consent + ACL. Need KMS audit and an approval gate. Also add `justification` text for exported full-identities.

sasha: Proposal sketch: export shape includes actor_hint, actor_role, actor_id_hash, change_payload, rollout_id, policy_id, timestamp, export_metadata. actor_hint is short human-friendly (e.g., "svc-payment-ingest"), actor_id_hash is HMAC with tenant key. Full_identity field only present if export_mode=\"full-identity\" and approved.

raj: Implementation notes — runtime should add a telemetry tag `export_sample_reason` and `export_sample_rate` when we do sampling. We should also record `telemetry_event: export_requested` with route, model, and quota_bucket.

sasha: Example NDJSON line (for discussion):
```
{"ts":"2026-03-10T14:02:03Z","policy_id":"route-prod-3","rollout_id":"canary-42","actor_hint":"alice-svc","actor_role":"admin","actor_id_hash":"hmac:abcd...","change":"updated routing weight 80->90","justification":"migrations prep","export_mode":"pseudonymized"}
```

morgan: Love the sample. For console UX: export modal should show what fields will be included and a toggle for pseudonymized vs full (with enterprise approval flow). Also show estimated size and quota cost up-front.

devex: We should expose a quick API `GET /v1/exports/{id}/manifest` that returns the exact schema and sample lines so customers can wire SIEM ingestion. The manifest should include a `fields` list and `redaction_notes`.

elena: Also add auditability for who approved the full-identity export. Approval event should be in the same ledger with `approver_id` and `approval_ts`. That must be immutable.

raj: Quotas: exports are expensive. We should have an export quota separate from API tokens: monthly export tokens and per-export cost estimate. Add preflight endpoint that returns `estimated_units` and will debit the quota on confirm.

sasha: On sampling: default server-side sampling policy = reservoir per-tenant per-day. Add `sample_seed` to export metadata so customers can deterministically reproduce which events were sampled.

morgan: UX: show sampled rate in console and in the exported manifest. Also let users request a re-run for a narrower timeframe (paid).

elena: Redaction modes we need to support: pseudonymize, redact_sensitive_fields (list), full_identity_with_approval. For compliance, keep a signed proof bundle that maps pseudonymized id->original for a limited TTL and only via an approved endpoint.

raj: Implementation API debate: should we compute actor_id_hash at write-time in the change event (cheap) or at export-time (flexible if key rotation)? If at export-time we must have raw actor_id accessible which increases risk.

sasha: Leaning export-time HMAC with a per-tenant export key stored in KMS and only accessible to export workers. That supports key rotation and keeps raw actor_id out of many systems.

devex: Small note — update SDK docs with examples and a sample `ndjson_schema` endpoint. Also add a CLI tool `ri export manifest` for customers.

morgan: For rollouts: include `rollout_stage` (canary/gradual/full) and `rollout_anchor` so audit can tie a change to a specific release.

elena: Add `tamper_proof_signature` in export_metadata (sign with platform signing key) so customers can verify integrity.

sasha: Next steps: 1) Raj to write export manifest PR with sample shape and sampling fields, 2) Elena drafts approval flow and KMS constraints, 3) Morgan designs modal with cost estimate and toggles, 4) Devex drafts manifest API and CLI.

raj: I'll start the PR today. Quick Q — do we want `actor_role` to be an enum or free text? Enum easier for policy lookups.

morgan: Enum with extension fields. Start with [admin, system, service, user, unknown].

elena: I'll post a short threat model doc and required audit entries here when ready.

sasha: Great — if folks agree, I'll create a tracked RFC. :thumbsup:
